LESSON: PLACES OF WORSHIP

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Worship (Ishwar Bhakti)
Topic 4.2: Places of Worship

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Places of Worship
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is the importance of features you see while visiting a Sikh Gurdwara?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the locations of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara (temples) in Kenya
2. classify the practices and ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara
3. appreciate ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 2: classify the practices and ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara

SECTION: WORK TO DO

2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT
